# SEO优化后获得ChatGPT和Perplexity询盘

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2025-06-19 21:32（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/1935692122327314937
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

在我们完成 SEO 工作后，客户开始从 ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 获得潜在客户。他问，这是否归功于我们的 SEO 策略。

简短回答：是。

没有 SEO = 没有 LLM 提及。

AI 会从各种来源获取内容，所以这些优化起到了作用！

我们仍然处在未知领域，但针对 Google AI Overviews 和 AI 聊天机器人做了一些具体调整后，已经看到一些成果。

而且，这件事不必让人感到不知所措。

你首先需要找出机会在哪里，然后理解运作机制。

例如，Google AI Overviews 的工作方式与其他 LLM 不同，因此要先理解机制。

举例来说，AI Overviews 与 Google 的“摘要”有一些相似之处，所以表达值得做得直接、简洁，同时具有对话感，就像你优化摘要时会做的那样。

示例文案：“从巴黎市中心乘坐 X、Y、Z 交通方式，可以在 30 分钟以内到达戴高乐机场。”用它来回答“前往 CDG 机场最快的方式是什么”。

ChatGPT 往往会提及更多品牌，所以你可能需要调整关键词与品牌提及的比例。

例如，我们大多数人以前被训练成写“巴塞罗那机场接送”，甚至根本不提品牌。

我认为，这一点必须改变。

你的服务是同质化商品，所以要开始让自己与众不同，使用品牌名称，掌握自己的叙事：更频繁地提及品牌，并在品牌、提供的服务和独特卖点上保持一致！

适用时，使用 Google Business Profile，以及来自“主流”网站的其他信号，例如 Wikipedia、TheFork、Yelp、http://reviews.io、Truspilot 等。

确保这些平台上的信息一致，也要把评价管理做好，就像创建知识面板时会做的那样。如果你不知道知识面板是什么，可以去查一下。

还有一个我测试得还不够充分、但想尝试的小方法：给网站添加更多 TL;DR 或核心要点，因为我认为这样能让 Google 的工作更省成本。我正在做几个实验，之后想在这里分享。

外链是信任信号，也可以是品牌信号。垃圾信息终究是垃圾信息。开始建设这些信号，并使用合适的工具追踪 AI 提及与流量。

## 英文原文

My client started getting leads from ChatGPT and Perplexity after our SEO work and and he's asking if it's due to our SEO stategy.

Quick answer: yes. 

No SEO = No LLM mentions.

AI consumes content from a variety of sources, so the optimization helped!

We are still in unchartered territory, but we're are seeing some results after specific tweaking for Google AI Overviews and AI Chatbots. 

And this doesn't needs to be overwhelming.

You first need to figure out where are your opportunities, and then understand the mechanism.

For example, Google AI Overviews works differently than other LLMs, so you want to understand the mechanisms first. 

E.g. the AI Overviews have some similarities wih the "snippets" from Google so it's worth to be direct and concise, but also, conversational. Just like you would do with the snippets

Example text: "You can get into Charles de Gaulle Airport under 30 minutes from the Paris' city center by taking an X, Y, Z transportation" as a response to "What is the faster way to get to CDG Airport"

ChatGPT tends to mention more brands, so you might want to switch your keyword-to-brand-mention ratio.

For example, most of us were trained to say "Transfer from Barcelona Airport" without even mentioning the brand.

I think that's got to change.

Your service is a commodity, so make sure you start differentiating yourself, use your brand's name and control your narrative: mention the brand more often and be consistent about it, about what you offer and your unique selling points!

If appropriate use your Google Business Profile and other signals from "mainstream" websites: wikipedia, thefork, yelp, http://reviews.io, truspilot, etc. 

Make sure your information is consistent across them and ensure you also get ahold of your review's management. Just like you would do creating your knowledge panel (look it up if you don't know what this is about)

Also, a little something that I haven't test enough but I want to do: adding more TL;DR or key takeaways to the websites, because I think that makes Google's work more economical. I'm running a few experiments I want to put here later.

Backlinks are trust signal, and they can also be are brand signals. Spam is spam. Start working on those and track your AI mentions and traffics with the right tools.
